title: 第27章 失望的龙雀
novel_title: 九恶妃每日一问，陛下驾崩了吗？
content_zh:
与此同时。

    秦然浑身一震。

    整个人诡异的睁开双眼。

    眼中的黑白色瞳孔，肉眼可见的被血色覆盖，血光如火焰般噌地燃起。

    他面皮抽搐着，五官时而扭曲，时而严肃，眼底深处藏着一丝癫狂……

    “桀桀桀。”

    他想控制住身体的变化，但口中却不受控制的发出一阵癫笑。

    不等他搞明白发生了什么。

    整个人的皮肤迅速干瘪，原本的肉色在眨眼间变成了一片漆黑。

    一个英俊非凡的青年，转瞬之间，化为了一尊面目狰狞的黑色恶鬼……

    “卧槽！”

    秦然要吓傻了。

    他尝试轻轻挥动了下手臂，看起来干干瘦瘦的手臂，却是重得吓人。

    他这一挥，竟是没能将手臂挥起来。

    “哥！你别搞我！！”

    秦然的心瞬间凉了半截。

    这可是寄予厚望的神魔精血，若是选错了，那他这所有努力可都白费了。

    不等他继续研究，浑身上下忽然传来一阵强烈疲惫感。

    下一瞬，他脑袋一晕，所有异样消失不见……

    心脏深处。

    鬼影再度浮现在黑潭之上，不过这一次，它紧闭双眸，似乎陷入了沉睡状态……

    秦然傻傻的盯着黑潭上的鬼影。

    “现在退货还来得及吗？”

    这是他穿书至今，最茫然、也最无助的一次。

    夜魇是他设计出来的，但也仅是在原著中提过一句，并未进行太多具体设定。

    眼下情况已然超出了认知，他搞不明白问题出在哪里。

    “难不成…我现在太弱？”

    “还是…鬼影需要养一阵子？”

    “不对！！”

    秦然忽然醒悟过来，“也许是因为…现在还没到夜晚！！”

    这一番云族始祖殿之行，秦然也不知该哭该笑。

    过程中发生的一切都是好的，唯独这夜魇，让他拿不定主意。

    两个时辰到。

    青铜大门再度裂开一道小小缝隙。

    秦然一袭镶金白龙袍，身形如飘絮，潇洒地从门内一闪而出。

    龙雀抱臂，倚在门外石柱上。
content_en:
at the same time.

Qin Ran was shocked.

The whole person opened his eyes strangely.

The black and white pupils in his eyes were visibly covered in blood, and the blood ignited like a flame.

His face was twitching, his facial features were sometimes twisted and sometimes serious, and there was a trace of madness hidden deep in his eyes...

"Jie Jie Jie."

He wanted to control the changes in his body, but he burst out laughing uncontrollably.

Before he could figure out what was going on.

The whole person's skin quickly shriveled, and the original flesh color turned into pitch black in the blink of an eye.

An extraordinary and handsome young man, in an instant, turned into a ferocious black devil...

"Fuck!"

Kieran was scared to death.

He tried to wave his arm gently. His arm looked dry and thin, but it was frighteningly heavy.

In this wave, he actually failed to raise his arm.

"Brother! Don't mess with me!!"

Qin Ran's heart suddenly went cold.

This is the essence and blood of gods and demons that he has high hopes for. If he chooses the wrong one, all his efforts will be in vain.

Before he could continue his research, he suddenly felt a strong sense of exhaustion all over his body.

The next moment, his head was dizzy, and all the strange things disappeared...

Deep in the heart.

The ghost appeared above the black pool again, but this time, it closed its eyes tightly and seemed to have fallen into a deep sleep...

Kieran stared stupidly at the ghostly figure on the black pool.

"Is it too late to return it now?"

This is the most confused and helpless time he has ever felt since entering the book.

Night Dire was designed by him, but he only mentioned it once in the original work without making many specific settings.

The situation was beyond cognition now, and he couldn't figure out what the problem was.

"Could it be that... I'm too weak now?"

"Or... the ghost needs to be raised for a while?"

"Wrong!!"

Qin Ran suddenly came to his senses, "Maybe it's because...it's not night yet!!"

During this trip to the Yun Clan's Ancestral Palace, Qin Ran didn't know whether to cry or laugh.

Everything that happened in the process was good, but this night nightmare made him undecided.

Two hours are up.

The bronze door once again cracked a small gap.

Qin Ran was dressed in a white dragon robe inlaid with gold, his figure was like floating catkins, and he flashed out of the door in a dashing way.

Long Que folded his arms and leaned on the stone pillar outside the door.
